headline: Saudi coalition says drone intercepted in Mecca region Tuesday
dek: Coalition: a drone was intercepted and destroyed in the Mecca region on Tuesday. Saree denied any Ansar Allah operations on Saudi territory on Tuesday, calling the coalition statement 'a slanderous and recycled lie'.
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesperson Turki al-Malki (social-media statement); Ansar Allah military spokesperson Yahya Saree; Ansar Allah health ministry statement
fault_line: Holy-city targeting claim vs 'recycled lie' denial: did anything fly toward Mecca on Tuesday, or is the intercept claim recycled?

sections.what_happened: Coalition: a drone was intercepted and destroyed in the Mecca region on Tuesday. Saree denied any Ansar Allah operations on Saudi territory on Tuesday, calling the coalition statement 'a slanderous and recycled lie'. Ansar Allah health ministry: Saudi strikes killed 17 civilians over two days this week, most of them children, targeting homes, residential neighbourhoods and markets. Saree (Monday evening): Riyadh carried out '109 strikes over the past 24 hours' in Saada, Taiz, Lahj, al-Jawf and Hodeidah. Context from Dawn Nov 3 edition (Monday fighting): Ansar Allah advanced to within 80 km of Aden, closest since 2015.
sections.what_verified: Intercept + denial pair carried by 2 declared-tier families (Gulf News T3, Daily Sabah T3). The 17-killed toll rests on the Ansar Allah health ministry alone (via FMT, which carries no declared tier and does not count); no independent verification. The 109-strikes figure is a Ansar Allah claim only.
sections.what_disputed: Direct contradiction on the core fact: coalition says a drone was intercepted in the Mecca region Tuesday; Saree says no Ansar Allah operations on Saudi territory occurred Tuesday. Saudi Arabia has repeatedly accused the Ansar Allah of targeting Mecca/Medina; the Ansar Allah systematically reject such accusations. No wreckage, flight-path or independent confirmation published for the Mecca-region drone. UN figures carried by the same reports: 1,600+ killed, 300,000+ displaced since fighting resumed.
sections.why_matters: Coalition says it downed a drone over Mecca's region; the Ansar Allah say nothing flew on Tuesday -- while claiming 17 civilians killed in Yemen over two days. Claim-bust frame: both halves, neither verified.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (published 13:37-15:33 , absent from all earlier Nov 3 scans) -- Saudi coalition says drone intercepted in Mecca region Tuesday; Ansar Allah deny any Tuesday operations on Saudi territory; Ansar Allah claim 17 civilians killed in Yemen over two days

Claim-bust frame: both halves, neither verified.
